signal: score = 1.0·z(EPS surprise) + 0.0·z(momentum) + 1.0·z(cheap P/E) + 1.0·z(AI-supply thesis) → long the top 30 eligible names

sizing.desc: Rank picks WHAT we hold; it does not set size. The top-30 are inverse-vol weighted (60d window), clamped at the per-name cap, then the whole book is scaled to the 10% vol target, gross-capped, and multiplied by the DD ladder x regime brake.

screen.desc: OPEN universe (all tradeable tokenized perps + new listings) → profitability-AGNOSTIC investability screen: analyst coverage ≥ 5 AND revenue ≥ $0B. Keeps unprofitable hypergrowth (CRWV/RKLB), drops speculative shells (ONDS/GME).

thesis_tilt.desc: picks-&-shovels tilt — +W·z(supplier role OR AI-supply sector). Captures the thesis systematically; conviction-weighted.

valuation_overlay.venue_note: Applied on every venue. Cheapness is a property of the SECURITY, not of the exchange listing it, so the leg is no longer venue-gated. The old 'off on Hyperliquid' rule rested on a confounded test: the HL universe scores ~40 names against a top-30 book, and at a 75% selection ratio no ranking signal can differentiate. The HL names are also a subset of the same Binance panel, so they are the same companies at the same multiples.
valuation_overlay.evidence: Passed robustness: helps in 100% of 18 param configs (median +0.40) + 2/3 sub-periods; rich tilt -0.57 (sign-consistent).

smart_money.note: 13F-HR, ~45-day lag; long-equity + puts only. # of tracked filers long the name, from the panel. Cross-check, not a selection input. Full books of 15 AI-frontier crossover funds are on the Smart Money tab.

ai_thesis: Own the AI hardware / supply chain (firms that RECEIVE AI capex as revenue). The thesis TILT (z_thesis) leans the book toward suppliers; hyperscalers that SPEND the capex are no longer BARRED (exclusion lifted 2026-08-02 after re-measurement showed its edge confined to the oldest sub-period), only out-ranked when the signal rates them lower.

coatue_evidence.source: Coatue, 'Market is rewarding the sellers of the shortage' (2026)
coatue_evidence.note: Backward-looking PRICE evidence. Retained as the origin of the supplier/spender framing, NOT as live justification for an exclusion: forward fundamentals (GS cloud revenue 39->48%, Baker OCF 31->50%) point the other way and the exclusion no longer measures as additive.

ai_finding: OPEN universe (all tradeable perps across Binance + Hyperliquid) → investability screen → eps+mom+val + thesis tilt, diversified top-30. NO hand-curation. 2026-08-02: the AI-capex SPENDER exclusion was LIFTED. It was introduced on a ~34-name panel and justified by Coatue's 'sellers of the shortage' +107% YTD vs 'buyers' +4% — a BACKWARD-LOOKING PRICE observation. Re-measured on the current 100-stock panel, with the revisions leg finally covering hyperscalers (previously 0.00 for all six, so they were handicapped in every earlier test): ex-spenders 3.62 Sharpe vs full universe 3.56, identical -10.2% DD, and the exclusion's entire edge sits in the OLDEST sub-period, having vanished in the two most recent (4.06 vs 4.04, then 3.55 vs 3.55). That decay matches the forward evidence: Goldman has hyperscaler cloud revenue growth 39%→48% Q1→Q2 2026, and Gavin Baker argues spot GPU rental ~2x contracted rates means the buyers are UNDER-earning. Suppliers-ONLY remains refuted (3.18 Sharpe, DD -15.6%). The thesis TILT (z_thesis) still leans the book toward suppliers — what changed is that spenders are no longer BARRED, only out-ranked.
note: Single-name selection research on the validated signal. Valuation overlay & 13F are CONTEXT/validation, not live selection inputs. Research, not investment advice.
